rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card, impostor table and dated predictions before real data; synthetic validation at real counts in both regimes and both models (found that the HH's literal composition null manufactures a slow mode; fixed as Amendment A1); replication on 33 periods plus regime-level slow-mode tests; two natives (G51, NE33/NE32); seven preprocessing variants with their own nulls; three post hoc rival checks; scorecard; frozen, guarded confirm script dry-run, not run. No holdout run, no carrier test.
rationale.faithfulness: The slow-mode contrast is 3x the synthetic composition null in both models in regime I, has the planted OU shape (tau 23-28 d, negative far-epoch similarity), survives member turnover (overlap-adjusted and size-matched disjoint), Gemini removal, scaffold segments and three exogenous covariates. It fails the interventional signature (no roster jumps), is absent inside #51 and marginal in regime III, and an unmeasured slow exogenous drift is not excluded. Scorecard A1 B1 C2 D1 E0 F2 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: First positive egregore result: a collective state variable with a measured timescale (~25 days) that outlives members. It tells an operator not to expect a goal change or a roster change to reset the village and to compare a village with its last 2-3 weeks. Practical leverage is limited until the carrier (record vs outside drift) is identified.
